5-Star Flavor, Freshness, Ambience with Exceptional service!
Apr 2026 • Couples
A Must-Visit Dining Experience in Hanoi – Exceptional in Every Way

Madame Hiên is truly a five-star dining experience from start to finish. The staff are incredibly welcoming, attentive, kind, and genuinely helpful, offering thoughtful recommendations that elevate the entire meal.

The food is absolutely delicious—rich in flavor with unique and beautifully presented options that showcase the best of Vietnamese cuisine. The setting is equally special, with a stunning historic building and decor that create a warm, elegant atmosphere (and even smells amazing the moment you walk in!).

We loved the thoughtful touches, like the palate cleanser before the meal and the digestive spice offered after dinner—details that make the experience feel extra refined and memorable.

Every member of the staff made us feel so welcome, and the entire evening was simply a joy. This is absolutely a place we would return to again and again—a true must-visit in Hanoi!
